warnings: This method measures smaller but may not free much actual RAM on short prompts, because its default path unpacks values back to full precision as it reads them. The size figure is real; treat it as a measure of how well the data compresses, not as RAM you get back.
recommendation.rationale: The safe everyday pick: it works out of the box with no setup step, and shrinks the key half of the cache by about 7.5x. It unpacks each value back to full precision as it is read, so this is a size measurement rather than a drop in live memory use.
